question: How many Core Plus Fixed Income managers does INPRS anticipate hiring under RFP 22-04, what is the combined mandate size, and what benchmark will be used?
gold_answer: Two managers, combined mandate size of approximately $185 million, benchmarked against the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Bond Index.
acceptance: Two, approximately $185m combined, Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Bond Index.
candidate_answer: INPRS anticipates hiring **two Core Plus Fixed Income managers** for a **combined mandate of approximately $185 million**. The strategies are expected to be benchmarked against the **Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Bond Index**. [RFP 22-04, p. 12](INPRS__RFP22-04CorePlusFixedIncomeInvestmentManagement_Final.pdf#page=12)
